add.title: LGBTQ rights in Nigeria (Wikipedia)
add.summary: Thin: no usable Sokoto-specific placement finding. The fetched Wikipedia article lists Sokoto among the twelve northern states whose Shari'a criminal codes apply to Muslims (alongside Bauchi, Kano, etc.), with maximum penalties of death-for-men / whipping-and/or-imprisonment-for-women for same-sex acts (per the ILGA citation the article reproduces), and documents cross-dressing criminalization in northern states (e.g., Kano's up-to-one-year prison term for men who dress or behave as women; a northern Islamic court imposing 10 lashes for cross-dressing). This is a criminalisation framework for Sokoto, but the article contains no Sokoto-specific arrest, trial, or custody case, no mention of where trans prisoners are housed, no trans special unit, and no solitary/segregation practice.
